subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is one of four elemental temples locked in constant conflict with Fire, Water, and Air temples. It seeks ultimate dominance by destroying the others, operates from deep subterranean levels, and grants the badge of Earth to those who prove their loyalty and capability.
source_quote: Romag’s mission for them was clear: destroy the other temples so the Earth Temple could seize ultimate power. Romag promised that once they proved themselves capable of operating within the temple by completing this mission, they would earn the right to wear the badge of Earth.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is the dominant faction within the Temple of Elemental Evil, seeking ultimate power by destroying the other elemental temples, led by Romag, with Dick Rentsch as a recruiter and enforcer, and its guards expressing loyalty to it and hatred for the Fire Temple, planning to kill enough gnolls to claim Alremm as their own.
source_quote: Romag, the High Priest of the Earth Temple... The guards expressed their loyalty to the Earth Temple and their hatred for the Fire Temple... once the Earth Temple destroyed the other false prophets... Romag’s mission for them was clear: destroy the other temples so the Earth Temple could seize ultimate power.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is a rival elemental faction, hated by the Earth Temple. Its head, Alremm, is targeted for destruction by Earth Temple guards, and its influence extends into the deeper levels of the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: The guards expressed their loyalty to the Earth Temple and their hatred for the Fire Temple, boasting that once they killed enough gnolls, Alremm—the head of the Fire Temple—would be theirs.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is a rival faction within the Temple of Elemental Evil, led by Alremm, whose servants are marked by the symbols the party found, and who is targeted for destruction by the Earth Temple as part of its campaign for supremacy.

subject: Gnolls

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil is a massive, leprous gray monument to darkness with ruined architecture, obscene carvings, and a pervasive aura of vileness; it is currently empty but intended to be filled with supplicants who will kill and bury alive opponents after the Earth Temple destroys false prophets.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil loomed as a massive structure far larger than imagined, with a ruined tower jutting from the northeast corner of shattered walls, standing like a leprous gray monument to darkness, its arched buttresses obscene and covered in climbing vegetation, every surface carved with leering faces and writhing forms depicting unspeakable obscenities, with a pervading sense of fear hanging over it like a tangible cloud of vileness, sounds distorted, movements flickering at the edges of vision, the wind moaning through hundreds of apertures like the wails of doomed souls, ravens croaking among the ruins, and the main entrance featuring two pairs of massive bronze doors twenty-three feet high and twenty feet wide, held fast by huge iron chains with all cracks sealed, graven with glowing runes that burned with silvery radiance.
source_quote: The Temple of Elemental Evil loomed before them, a massive structure far larger than they had imagined. A ruined tower jutted from the northeast corner of shattered walls, and the temple itself stood like a leprous gray monument to darkness. Its arched buttresses were obscene, covered in climbing vegetation, and every surface was carved with leering faces and writhing forms depicting unspeakable obscenities. A pervading sense of fear hung over the entire area like a tangible cloud of vileness. Sounds seemed distorted, and movements flickered at the edges of their vision. The wind moaned through hundreds of apertures in the temple walls, creating sounds like the wails of doomed souls, while ravens croaked and flapped among the ruins. The main entrance featured two pairs of massive bronze doors, twenty-three feet high and twenty feet wide, held fast by huge iron chains with all cracks sealed. Graven upon these doors were glowing runes that burned with silvery radiance, making their eyes water to look upon.

source_quote: Romag promised that once they proved themselves capable of operating within the temple by completing this mission, they would earn the right to wear the badge of Earth.

subject: Broken crystal vessels
fact: Shards of broken crystal vessels surround the circular pit beneath the central altar, their purpose and origin unknown.

subject: bronze doors dimensions
fact: The main entrance features two pairs of massive bronze doors, twenty-three feet high and twenty feet wide.
source_quote: The main entrance featured two pairs of massive bronze doors, twenty-three feet high and twenty feet wide.

subject: bronze square dimensions
fact: In the center stood a great pierced bronze square.
source_quote: In the center stood a great pierced bronze square.

subject: Central altar of pinkish-white marble
fact: The central altar is carved with a disturbing human-shaped depression stained dark with old blood, located in a chamber beneath the temple’s vestibule, and surrounded by a circular pit.

subject: chest description
fact: The party presented the Chest of Rao to Romag.
source_quote: The party presented the Chest of Rao to Romag.

subject: Chest of Rao
fact: The Chest of Rao is a sacred artifact presented to Romag by the party, confirming their compliance with his initial demand and serving as proof of their usefulness to the Earth Temple.
source_quote: He asked for the Chest of Rao, and the party presented it to him.

subject: Chest of Rao
fact: The Chest of Rao was presented to Romag by the party after he asked for it.
source_quote: Romag asked for the Chest of Rao, and the party presented it to him.

subject: crystal braziers
fact: Crystal braziers suspended from silver chains emitted sickly sweet perfume smoke.
source_quote: crystal braziers suspended from silver chains emitted sickly sweet perfume smoke

subject: crystal braziers scent
fact: Crystal braziers suspended from silver chains emitted sickly sweet perfume smoke.
source_quote: Crystal braziers suspended from silver chains emitted sickly sweet perfume smoke.

subject: glowing runes on bronze doors
fact: Glowing runes burned with silvery radiance upon the bronze doors of the temple.
source_quote: Graven upon these doors were glowing runes that burned with silvery radiance

subject: Glowing runes on bronze doors
fact: Glowing runes burned with silvery radiance upon the twenty-three-foot-high bronze doors of the Temple of Elemental Evil, causing the party’s eyes to water when looked upon, and were deliberately avoided by Dick Rentsch.

subject: great pierced bronze square
fact: In the center of the octagonal room stood a great pierced bronze square.
source_quote: In the center stood a great pierced bronze square

subject: map of gnoll locations
fact: Dick Rentsch provided the party with a map showing where the gnolls could be found.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch provided them with a map showing where the gnolls could be found

subject: map of gnoll territories
fact: Dick Rentsch provided the party with a map showing gnoll locations and hostile faction-controlled territory, but omitted that the path led directly into the Air Temple’s domain.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch provided them with a map showing where the gnolls could be found, explaining that they would need to navigate through territory controlled by multiple hostile factions.

subject: Map of Gnoll Territory
fact: Dick Rentsch provided the party with a map showing where the gnolls could be found, explaining they would need to navigate through territory controlled by multiple hostile factions.

subject: runes radiance
fact: Graven upon these doors were glowing runes that burned with silvery radiance, making their eyes water to look upon.
source_quote: Graven upon these doors were glowing runes that burned with silvery radiance, making their eyes water to look upon.

subject: Scroll with ancient markings
fact: A scroll bearing ancient markings was discovered on the bodies of the dead, though its contents and origin remain unexamined.

subject: scroll with ancient markings
fact: The party discovered a scroll bearing ancient markings among the items of interest.
source_quote: the party discovered several items of interest: a scroll bearing ancient markings...

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.

subject: symbols marking servants of the Temple of Fire
fact: Symbols on the dead gnolls marked them as servants of the Temple of Fire.
source_quote: symbols marking the dead as servants of the Temple of Fire

subject: Symbols Marking the Dead as Servants of the Temple of Fire
fact: The party discovered symbols marking the dead as servants of the Temple of Fire among the items of interest.
source_quote: the party discovered several items of interest: ... and symbols marking the dead as servants of the Temple of Fire.

subject: Three Ornate Gold Buttons
fact: The party discovered three ornate gold buttons among the items of interest.
source_quote: the party discovered several items of interest: ... three ornate gold buttons...

subject: three ornate gold buttons
fact: The party discovered three ornate gold buttons on the dead gnolls.
source_quote: three ornate gold buttons

subject: Three ornate gold buttons
fact: Three ornate gold buttons were found on the bodies, marked as symbols of service to the Temple of Fire.

subject: Dick Rentsch’s deception
fact: It remains unclear whether Dick Rentsch’s failure to warn the party about the Air Temple’s territory was due to negligence, ignorance, or deliberate sabotage. His actions have placed them in extreme danger and may be part of a larger test or betrayal.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch had not simply sent them down a hallway—he had deposited them directly into enemy territory belonging to a rival elemental faction. Whether this was a test of their abilities or something more sinister remained unclear.

subject: Dick Rentsch's true intentions
fact: Dick Rentsch's motives for depositing the party into enemy territory remain unclear.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch had not simply sent them down a hallway—he had deposited them directly into enemy territory belonging to a rival elemental faction.

subject: Dick Rentsch's true motives
fact: It remained unclear whether Dick Rentsch’s actions were a test or something more sinister.
source_quote: Whether this was a test of their abilities or something more sinister remained unclear

subject: Fate of the Temple of Fire symbols
fact: Symbols marking the dead as servants of the Temple of Fire were found on the bodies, but their connection to the current Temple of Elemental Evil remains unexplained.

subject: Identity of the mysterious fungus
fact: Strange fungus, unlike any seen before, covered bones and vegetation in the temple grounds and pit, but its origin and properties are unknown.

subject: Nature of Dick Rentsch’s allegiance
fact: Dick Rentsch is disturbingly at ease in the Temple of Elemental Evil and calls it his happy place; his true allegiance and role within the temple are unclear.

subject: Origin of the great battle in the Bone Corridor
fact: The Bone Corridor is filled with skeletons from a great battle, but the identity of the combatants and the cause of the conflict remain unknown.

subject: party's survival in Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The party was now deep within the Temple of Elemental Evil, surrounded by ancient evil and warring factions, with only their wits and weapons to see them through.
source_quote: they were now deep within the Temple of Elemental Evil, surrounded by ancient evil and warring factions, with only their wits and weapons to see them through the trials ahead

subject: Purpose of the human-shaped depression
fact: The human-shaped depression on the central altar is stained with old blood; its ritual or functional purpose remains unexplained.

subject: the deeper secrets of the Temple
fact: Romag hinted that beyond the four elemental temples lie deeper levels containing unknown secrets and the true source of the Temple of Elemental Evil’s power. The party’s mission has only just begun.
source_quote: Below that lay the deeper temple and deeper secrets.

subject: The true nature of the Air Temple’s presence
fact: It is unclear whether the party’s placement in the Air Temple is a test or a betrayal.
source_quote: Whether this was a test of their abilities or something more sinister remained unclear.
